concept: À 5 h du matin, dans une boulangerie encore noire, une boulangère sans équipe décrit ce qu'elle veut à son studio de pub dans le navigateur ; par raccords de montage, son croquis devient un gâteau en 3D, son logo de farine une carte imprimée, sa rue vide une vitrine qui joue sa pub. Quand le premier client pousse la porte, elle tient son dépliant, sa carte, son film et son gâteau en 3D : toute une campagne, faite en une conversation.
accroche: Une rue enneigée à 5 h du matin, une seule lueur d'ordinateur dans une boulangerie noire, et la voix : « Cinq heures du matin. »
produit_evident: Dès 2,5 s on voit la boulangère de dos devant un portable rempli de vignettes d'images et de vidéos, avec le titre « Votre studio de pub dans le navigateur » ; à 7 s son croquis devient un rendu 3D.

plans.intention: Accroche : la nuit, le froid, une seule lueur d'écran dans la boulangerie.
plans.image: Wide cinematic night shot of a small corner bakery on a snowy empty street in an old Quebec neighbourhood at five in the morning, brick facade, dark shop window with a single cold blue glow from a laptop inside, falling snow lit by one sodium streetlight, blank unlit shop sign, deep navy and amber palette, 35mm lens, low angle, symmetrical composition, atmospheric haze, photographic realism
plans.mouvement: Snow falls steadily through the streetlight beam; slow push-in toward the glowing shop window; a light gust moves loose snow along the sidewalk.
plans.son: winter wind, distant snowplow, muffled silence

plans.intention: Produit évident : la boulangère devant son studio de pub dans le navigateur.
plans.image: Interior of a dark artisan bakery before dawn, seen from behind: a woman baker with dark curly hair in a bun, cream knit sweater and mustard-yellow apron, standing at a flour-dusted wooden counter before an open laptop whose screen shows a blurry grid of glowing image and video thumbnails in warm orange and teal, steel mixing bowls, racks of empty trays, screen light rim-lighting her shoulders, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field, moody chiaroscuro
plans.mouvement: Slow dolly forward over her shoulder toward the laptop; the blurred thumbnails on the screen shimmer and shift; flour dust floats in the screen light.

plans.intention: Le point de départ : un croquis de gâteau au crayon.
plans.image: Overhead close shot of a flour-dusted wooden counter beside a laptop keyboard: a rough pencil sketch on cream paper of a three-tier cake decorated with berries and wheat sprigs, a pencil and a sprinkle of flour beside it, warm screen glow from the top edge, dark surroundings, centred composition, 50mm lens, tactile paper texture, no writing anywhere on the paper
plans.mouvement: A flour-dusted hand slides the sketch to the centre of the frame and lifts away; camera slowly pushes down toward the drawing.
plans.son: paper sliding on wood, pencil set down

plans.intention: Transformation 1 (raccord de composition) : le croquis devient un gâteau rendu en 3D.
plans.image: Overhead centred shot with the same framing as a cake sketch on a counter: a photoreal three-tier cake with fresh berries and golden wheat sprigs, glossy cream frosting, floating above a dark polished surface as a studio 3D render, thin orange light rays sweeping behind it, soft reflection below, deep black background with warm amber accents, 50mm lens, ultra-detailed, cinematic product lighting
plans.mouvement: The cake rotates slowly on its axis, a band of warm light sweeps across the frosting, tiny flour particles drift upward; slow push-in.
plans.camera: 50 mm, plongée, rotation lente du sujet

plans.intention: Le logo de départ : un épi de blé pressé dans la farine.
plans.image: Top-down shot of a dark walnut bakery counter where a simple wheat-sprig emblem is pressed flat into a thin layer of white flour like a stamp mark, a small wooden stamp resting beside it, warm low side light from the left revealing the relief, no letters, minimalist centred composition, 50mm lens, high contrast, amber and charcoal palette
plans.mouvement: A hand lifts the wooden stamp out of frame; loose flour settles around the emblem; the side light slowly brightens.
plans.son: soft thud of wood on counter

plans.intention: Transformation 2 (raccord) : le logo plat devient une carte d'affaires imprimée.
plans.image: Top-down centred shot on a dark walnut counter with the same framing: a single thick cream business card with a blind-embossed wheat-sprig emblem in the centre and a thin mustard-yellow edge, no letters or numbers, a dusting of flour around it, warm low side light from the left catching the embossing, minimalist, 50mm lens, amber and charcoal palette, premium print texture
plans.mouvement: A flour-dusted fingertip slides the card a few centimetres forward; raking light glides across the embossed emblem; slow slight push-in.

plans.intention: Le dépliant sort de l'imprimante, chaud comme le pain.
plans.image: Low angle close shot of a compact home printer on a bakery shelf feeding out a glossy flyer printed with a vivid photograph of golden croissants and berries, no text on the flyer, warm tungsten work light, bread racks blurred in the background with bokeh, dark window behind, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, warm amber and cream palette
plans.mouvement: The glossy flyer slides out of the printer toward the camera and drops onto the tray; reflections glide across its surface; camera tilts down gently.

plans.intention: L'agent producteur : prix annoncé d'abord, la plus belle des deux prises retenue.
plans.image: Close shot of a laptop screen in a dark bakery, the screen out of focus showing two side-by-side glowing video frames of a golden bakery scene, the right frame outlined by a soft orange glow, a small blurry rounded panel beneath them, flour on the keyboard edge in sharp focus, reflections of warm light, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, teal and orange palette, no readable text
plans.mouvement: The left frame dims while the right frame brightens and grows slightly; a soft light pulse; slow push-in toward the screen.

plans.intention: Récompense : on entre dans son film de 30 secondes, la boulangère devient l'héroïne de sa propre pub.
plans.image: Cinematic commercial shot inside a rustic bakery at dawn: a woman baker seen from the side and behind, dark curly hair in a bun, cream knit sweater and mustard-yellow apron, pulling a tray of golden croissants out of a glowing brick oven, thick steam rising through shafts of warm light, face turned away into shadow, 35mm anamorphic look, rich amber and deep brown palette, fine film grain, shallow depth of field
plans.mouvement: She slides the tray out of the oven toward camera, steam billows and curls through the light beams, embers glow; slow lateral dolly with a gentle push.

plans.intention: Personnage constant : la même héroïne, un autre plan de son film.
plans.image: Wide backlit shot of a woman baker with dark curly hair in a bun, cream knit sweater and mustard-yellow apron, walking away down a snowy cobblestone street at sunrise carrying a wicker basket of baguettes, long shadow on the snow, golden low sun haze, old stone houses, 50mm lens, silhouette, warm gold and soft blue palette, cinematic film grain
plans.mouvement: She walks slowly away from camera, snow sparkles in the sun, steam rises from the bread; camera tracks forward behind her.
plans.son: footsteps on snow, distant church bell

plans.intention: Le montage suit la musique : la farine danse sur le temps.
plans.image: Macro shot of a small wooden bookshelf speaker on a bakery shelf, a thin layer of flour on top of it and on the shelf, warm rim light from behind, dark background, flour particles suspended in the air, 100mm macro lens, shallow depth of field, amber and black palette, high contrast, plain unbranded speaker
plans.mouvement: Flour particles jump and dance on the speaker with each bass beat, small clouds of flour puff upward into the backlight; nearly locked-off camera with a subtle push.

plans.intention: Respiration : la rue est encore vide.
plans.image: Wide shot of a small corner bakery on a snowy empty street at blue hour, brick facade, shop window dark, blank sign, no people, fresh untouched snow on the sidewalk, cold blue palette with a hint of pink sky, one streetlight, 35mm lens, low angle, symmetrical composition, quiet and still, photographic realism
plans.mouvement: Very slow push-in toward the dark shop window; light snowflakes drift down; the sky slowly brightens.

plans.intention: Transformation 3 (raccord) : la rue vide devient une vitrine qui joue sa pub.
plans.image: Wide shot of a small corner bakery on a snowy street at sunrise with the same symmetrical low-angle framing, the shop window now glowing warm gold with a large screen inside playing a blurry cinematic image of golden croissants and steam, glossy colourful flyers taped inside the glass, warm light spilling onto the snow, pink and gold sky, 35mm lens, photographic realism, no readable text
plans.mouvement: Warm light blooms across the window and spills onto the snow; the blurred images on the screen inside shift softly; slow push-in; snow glitters.

plans.intention: Le premier client pousse la porte.
plans.image: Wide interior shot from behind a bakery counter looking toward the glass door at sunrise: a silhouetted customer in a winter coat and knit hat pushing the door open, snow swirling in, golden backlight, small brass bell above the door, warm display cases of pastries in the foreground softly blurred, 35mm lens, anamorphic flare, amber and cool blue contrast
plans.mouvement: The door swings open slowly, snow and cold air swirl in through the golden backlight, the bell sways; camera holds, then pushes gently.
plans.son: shop door bell jingle, gust of wind

plans.intention: Toute la campagne dans ses mains : dépliant, carte, film, gâteau en 3D.
plans.image: Over-the-shoulder shot from behind a woman baker in a mustard-yellow apron and cream knit sweater, dark curly hair in a bun, at her counter at sunrise, holding a glossy croissant flyer and a cream embossed business card fanned in one hand, beside her a finished three-tier berry cake, an open laptop playing a blurry warm video and a tablet showing a softly glowing 3D cake shape, golden sunlight through the window, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field
plans.mouvement: She raises the flyer and card slightly toward the light, sunbeams sweep across the counter, steam rises from fresh bread; slow orbit around her shoulder.

plans.intention: Finale : la boulangerie s'éveille, la rue se remplit.
plans.image: Wide exterior shot of a small corner bakery at full sunrise, warm gold window glowing, two silhouetted customers walking in carrying paper bags, steam rising from a roof vent, snow sparkling on the sidewalk, long shadows, pink and gold sky over old brick houses, blank sign, 35mm lens, crane-height angle, cinematic, photographic realism
plans.mouvement: Slow crane up and back revealing the street waking up; steam drifts from the roof; snow sparkles; customers walk slowly toward the door.
plans.son: street waking up, door bell, birds

narration.texte: Elle ouvre dans deux heures, pis elle a pas d'équipe.
Alors elle décrit ce qu'elle veut.
Son gâteau prend forme. Son logo devient une carte.
Le producteur annonce le prix, pis choisit la plus belle prise.
Elle reste elle-même, d'un plan à l'autre.
Pis là, sa pub s'allume dans la vitrine.
Premier client. Elle a son dépliant, sa carte, son film, pis son gâteau en trois D.

musique.description: EN: Opens with felt piano and soft room ambience, then pizzicato strings and a gentle kick pulse, building with warm cellos, claps and bright glockenspiel into an uplifting full-band finale with big low drums and a soaring string line; emotional, hopeful, morning-light feeling; clean wide mix, voice-friendly midrange, clear accents on the announced hits.

sections.description: EN: sparse felt piano, cold airy pad, quiet anticipation
EN: pizzicato strings and soft kick pulse enter, curiosity and momentum
EN: cellos, claps and glockenspiel, steady driving rhythm, confident
EN: drums drop out, piano and held strings only, hushed
EN: full drums and soaring string melody, warm and triumphant
EN: final chord resolving, piano tail and soft ring-out

fin.sous_titre: Le studio IA de l'image, de la vidéo, du son, de la 3D et de l'imprimé
